svg.text: Editable physical panels with cable connections inside the sockets.
SW1 port 4 -> PP1 port 1 -> AP1 PoE/LAN
SW1 port 6 -> PP1 port 3 -> DS1 port 1
Rack faces touch at 1U intervals. Short patch leads run to PP1; longer runs continue to the office devices.
Each socket is one cable endpoint. Spare ports are intentionally left open; this drawing has no SPICE model.
